    39	private theorem totalDegree_le_of_exponents {F : Type*} [CommSemiring F]
    40	    {n d : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F)
    41	    (h : ∀ e ∈ p.support, ∀ i, e i ≤ d) : p.totalDegree ≤ n * d := by
    42	  rw [MvPolynomial.totalDegree, Finset.sup_le_iff]
    43	  intro e he
    44	  rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (by simp)]
    45	  calc
    46	    ∑ i : Fin n, e i ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, d := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => h e he i
    47	    _ = n * d := by simp
    48	
    49	private theorem sumRingEquiv_degrees {F : Type*} [CommSemiring F] {k n d : ℕ}
    50	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k ⊕ Fin n) F)
    51	    (h : ∀ e ∈ p.support, ∀ i, e i ≤ d) :
    52	    (∀ a, ((MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F (Fin k) (Fin n) p).coeff a).totalDegree ≤
    53	      n * d) ∧ (MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F (Fin k) (Fin n) p).totalDegree ≤ k * d := by
    54	  have hc (a : Fin k →₀ ℕ) (b : Fin n →₀ ℕ)
    55	      (hb : b ∈ ((MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F (Fin k) (Fin n) p).coeff a).support) :
    56	      Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp.symm (a, b) ∈ p.support := by
    57	    simpa only [MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff, coeff_coeff_sumRingEquiv] using hb
    58	  constructor
    59	  · intro a
    60	    apply totalDegree_le_of_exponents
    61	    intro b hb i
    62	    simpa using h _ (hc a b hb) (Sum.inr i)
    63	  · apply totalDegree_le_of_exponents
    64	    intro a ha i
    65	    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := MvPolynomial.support_nonempty.mpr
    66	      (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp ha)
    67	    simpa using h _ (hc a b hb) (Sum.inl i)
    68	
    69	/-- The two base blocks, in the order `x,z` used by the extended game. -/
    70	def baseCoordinateEquiv (m : ℕ) : Fin (2 * m) ≃ Fin m ⊕ Fin m :=
    71	  (finCongr (by omega)).trans finSumFinEquiv.symm
    72	
    73	/-- The scalar coordinates first, followed by the combined base coordinates. -/
    74	def scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv (m : ℕ) : Fin (2 * m + 2) ≃ Fin 2 ⊕ Fin (2 * m) :=
    75	  (finCombineEquiv m).trans
    76	    ((Equiv.sumCongr (baseCoordinateEquiv m).symm (Equiv.refl _)).trans
    77	      (Equiv.sumComm _ _))
    78	
    79	/-- The actual singleton outcome as a polynomial in `alpha,beta` with
    80	coefficients in the `2m` base variables, over the canonical Pauli field. -/
    81	def scalarPolynomial (P : AdmissibleParams) (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
    82	    MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P)) :=
    83	  MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv _ _ _
    84	    (MvPolynomial.rename (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
    85	      (MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1))
    86	
    87	private theorem scalarPolynomial_renamed_exponents (P : AdmissibleParams)
    88	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
    89	    ∀ e ∈ (MvPolynomial.rename (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
    90	      (MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1)).support,
    91	      ∀ i, e i ≤ P.d := by
    92	  intro e he i
    93	  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvp⟩ := MvPolynomial.coeff_rename_ne_zero _ _ _
    94	    (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp he)
    95	  have hmem := MvPolynomial.support_map_subset _ _ (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hvp)
    96	  have hdeg := Preliminaries.degreeOf_le_of_mem_polyFunc (g (0 : Fin 1)).2
    97	    ((scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm i)
    98	  have hvbound := (MvPolynomial.le_degreeOf_of_mem_support _ hmem).trans hdeg
    99	  change v ((scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm i) ≤ P.d at hvbound
   100	  subst e
   101	  simpa only [Finsupp.mapDomain_equiv_apply] using hvbound

   103	/-- Both degree bounds follow from the genuine individual-degree certificate:
   104	every base coefficient has degree at most `2md`, and the outer scalar
   105	polynomial has degree at most `2d`. No degree hypothesis is added. -/
   106	theorem scalarPolynomial_degrees (P : AdmissibleParams)
   107	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
   108	    (∀ a, ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a).totalDegree ≤ 2 * P.m * P.d) ∧
   109	      (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree ≤ 2 * P.d := by
   110	  exact sumRingEquiv_degrees _ (scalarPolynomial_renamed_exponents P g)
   111	
   112	/-- Split a base coefficient into a polynomial in either varying block with
   113	coefficients in the fixed block. The order parameter selects either `x` or `z`
   114	as the varying block. This supports the two applications of `eq:qld-g-2` in
   115	paper lines 1341--1358 and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   116	def blockCoefficientPolynomial (P : AdmissibleParams)
   117	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool) :
   118	    MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (PauliScalar P)) :=
   119	  MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv _ _ _ (MvPolynomial.rename
   120	    ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   121	      (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)) ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a))
   122	
   123	private theorem blockCoefficientPolynomial_renamed_exponents (P : AdmissibleParams)
   124	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool) :
   125	    ∀ e ∈ (MvPolynomial.rename ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   126	      (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _))
   127	        ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a)).support, ∀ i, e i ≤ P.d := by
   128	  intro e he i
   129	  let eqv := (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   130	    (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)
   131	  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvp⟩ := MvPolynomial.coeff_rename_ne_zero _ _ _
   132	    (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp he)
   133	  have hcoeff :
   134	      (MvPolynomial.rename (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
   135	        (MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1)).coeff
   136	        (Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp.symm (a, v)) ≠ 0 := by
   137	    simpa only [scalarPolynomial, coeff_coeff_sumRingEquiv] using hvp
   138	  have hb := scalarPolynomial_renamed_exponents P g _
   139	    (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hcoeff) (.inr (eqv.symm i))
   140	  change v (eqv.symm i) ≤ P.d at hb
   141	  subst e
   142	  simpa only [Finsupp.mapDomain_equiv_apply] using hb
   143	
   144	/-- Both partial degrees are at most `md`, for either choice of varying
   145	block, directly from the actual outcome's individual-degree certificate.
   146	This supplies the coefficient and fiber bounds in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting
   147	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`; no degree or specialization premise is added. -/
   148	theorem blockCoefficientPolynomial_degrees (P : AdmissibleParams)
   149	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool) :
   150	    (∀ e, ((blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse).coeff e).totalDegree ≤ P.m * P.d) ∧
   151	      (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse).totalDegree ≤ P.m * P.d := by
   152	  exact sumRingEquiv_degrees _ (blockCoefficientPolynomial_renamed_exponents P g a reverse)
   153	
   154	/-- The field and coordinate transports preserve the complete singleton
   155	polynomial outcome, including its formal coefficients, not only its values. -/
   156	theorem scalarPolynomial_injective (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   157	    Function.Injective (scalarPolynomial P) := by
   158	  intro g h heq
   159	  have hs := (MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv (PauliScalar P) (Fin 2)
   160	    (Fin (2 * P.m))).injective heq
   161	  have hr := MvPolynomial.rename_injective (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
   162	    (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m).injective hs
   163	  have hc := MvPolynomial.map_injective (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom
   164	    (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).injective hr
   165	  funext j
   166	  have hj : j = (0 : Fin 1) := @Subsingleton.elim (Fin 1) _ j 0
   167	  subst j
   168	  exact Subtype.ext hc

   170	/-- The combined degree term in the concentration estimate. -/
   171	theorem scalarPolynomial_degree_term_le (P : AdmissibleParams)
   172	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
   173	    ((scalarPolynomial P g).support.sup fun e =>
   174	      ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff e).totalDegree) +
   175	        max 1 (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree + 1 ≤ (2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 := by
   176	  have h := scalarPolynomial_degrees P g
   177	  have hc : ((scalarPolynomial P g).support.sup fun e =>
   178	      ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff e).totalDegree) ≤ 2 * P.m * P.d :=
   179	    Finset.sup_le fun e _ => h.1 e
   180	  have ho : max 1 (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree ≤ 2 * P.d :=
   181	    max_le (by have := P.hd; omega) h.2
   182	  calc
   183	    _ ≤ 2 * P.m * P.d + 2 * P.d + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.add_le_add hc ho) 1
   184	    _ = _ := by ring

   186	private theorem eval_sumRingEquiv {F A B : Type*} [CommSemiring F]
   187	    (p : MvPolynomial (A ⊕ B) F) (u : B → F) (v : A → F) :
   188	    MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u)
   189	      (MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F A B p)) = MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim v u) p := by
   190	  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
   191	  | C a => simp
   192	  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
   193	  | mul_X p i hp => cases i <;> simp [hp]

   195	/-- Split the full joint uniform point into the base point and scalar point.
   196	This is one equivalence of sample spaces, not four marginal identifications. -/
   197	def scalarBaseQuestionEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   198	    ((Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P) × (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) ≃
   199	      ExtendedPointQuestion P :=
   200	  (((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).piCongrLeft fun _ => PauliScalar P).trans
   201	    (Equiv.sumPiEquivProdPi fun _ : Fin P.m ⊕ Fin P.m => PauliScalar P)).prodCongr
   202	      (finTwoArrowEquiv (PauliScalar P))
   203	
   204	private theorem scalarBaseQuestionEquiv_direct (P : AdmissibleParams)
   205	    (u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) :
   206	    (directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv P).symm (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)) =
   207	      fun i => (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm
   208	        (Sum.elim v u (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m i)) := by
   209	  apply (directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv P).injective
   210	  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv_apply]
   211	  apply Prod.ext
   212	  · apply Prod.ext <;> funext i <;>
   213	      simp [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv, scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv, projX, projZ,
   214	        embX, embZ, directPointToPauli, Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply]
   215	  · apply Prod.ext <;>
   216	      simp [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv, scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv, alphaVar, betaVar,
   217	        directPointToPauli]
   218	
   219	/-- Evaluation of the nested polynomial is exactly the actual singleton readout,
   220	including the canonical field transport and all four coordinate blocks. -/
   221	theorem scalarPolynomial_eval (P : AdmissibleParams)
   222	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd)
   223	    (u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) :
   224	    MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (scalarPolynomial P g)) =
   225	      extendedPolynomialRead P (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)) g := by
   226	  rw [scalarPolynomial, eval_sumRingEquiv, MvPolynomial.eval_rename,
   227	    MvPolynomial.eval_map]
   228	  unfold extendedPolynomialRead evalDirectPolyTupleAt
   229	  rw [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv_direct]
   230	  have h := (MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom
   231	      (fun i => (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm
   232	        (Sum.elim v u (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m i))) (g (0 : Fin 1)).1).symm
   233	  change MvPolynomial.eval₂ (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom
   234	      (fun i => extendedDirectScalarEquiv P ((extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm
   235	        (Sum.elim v u (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m i)))) (g (0 : Fin 1)).1 = _ at h
   236	  simp only [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
   237	  exact h
   238	
   239	/-- Exact partial evaluation for either block order. This is the coefficient
   240	specialization used in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   241	theorem blockCoefficientPolynomial_eval (P : AdmissibleParams)
   242	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool)
   243	    (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   244	    MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   245	      (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse)) =
   246	    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => Sum.elim x z
   247	      (((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   248	        (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)) i))
   249	      ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a) := by
   250	  rw [blockCoefficientPolynomial, eval_sumRingEquiv, MvPolynomial.eval_rename]
   251	  rfl
   252	
   253	/-- Joint sample equivalence for the fiber calculation: the first input block
   254	is fixed and the second varies. Reversal exchanges both the point blocks and
   255	the scalar coefficients, so its ordered product is `ZX`. This supports the
   256	two orders in `eq:qld-g-42/43` and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   257	def fiberQuestionEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) (reverse : Bool) :
   258	    (((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) ×
   259	      (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) ≃ ExtendedPointQuestion P :=
   260	  (if reverse then Equiv.refl _ else Equiv.prodComm _ _).prodCongr
   261	    ((finTwoArrowEquiv (PauliScalar P)).trans
   262	      (if reverse then Equiv.prodComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _))
   263	
   264	/-- For a scalar-linear outcome, its actual readout equals the two specialized
   265	coefficient polynomials in the corresponding block and scalar order. This is
   266	an exact identity, with no field-size condition; support for `eq:qld-g-48`
   267	and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   268	theorem scalarPolynomial_linear_read_fiber (P : AdmissibleParams)
   269	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd)
   270	    (hg : ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P),
   271	      scalarPolynomial P g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   272	        MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   273	    (reverse : Bool) (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) :
   274	    extendedPolynomialRead P (fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v)) g =
   275	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   276	        (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 1 else 0) 1)
   277	          reverse)) +
   278	      v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   279	        (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 0 else 1) 1)
   280	          reverse)) := by
   281	  obtain ⟨r, t, hg⟩ := hg
   282	  let u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P := fun i => Sum.elim x z
   283	    (((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   284	      (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)) i)
   285	  let v' : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P := if reverse then ![v 1, v 0] else v
   286	  have heq : scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v') =
   287	      fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v) := by
   288	    cases reverse <;> simp [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv, fiberQuestionEquiv, u, v',
   289	      Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply]
   290	  rw [← heq, ← scalarPolynomial_eval, hg]
   291	  simp_rw [blockCoefficientPolynomial_eval, hg]

   318	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool)
   319	    (h : ∃ r, blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse = MvPolynomial.C r) :
   320	    ∃ r : Poly P, (scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a = MvPolynomial.rename
   321	      (fun i => ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   322	        (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)).symm (.inr i)) r.1 := by
   323	  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h
   324	  have hmem : r ∈ Preliminaries.polyFunc P.m (PauliScalar P) P.d := by

   328	    intro b hb

   332	    have hsupport : Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp.symm (0, b) ∈

   355	    (f h : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (PauliScalar P)) :

   367	      Sum.inr ∘ (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inr i)) := by

   382	outcome in the existing bounded `combinePoly` image. The two components have
   383	individual degree at most `d`, not merely total degree at most `md`.
   384	This identifies the separated image in `eq:qld-g-non-separable` with
   385	`def:combine-map`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   386	theorem exists_polyPair_of_scalar_separated (P : AdmissibleParams)
   387	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd)
   388	    (hlin : ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P),
   389	      scalarPolynomial P g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   390	        MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   391	    (hX : ∃ r, blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single 0 1) true = MvPolynomial.C r)
   392	    (hZ : ∃ r, blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single 1 1) false = MvPolynomial.C r) :
   393	    ∃ pair : PolyPair P,
   394	      MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1 =
   395	        combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1 := by
   396	  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := blockCoefficientPolynomial_const g _ true hX
   397	  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := blockCoefficientPolynomial_const g _ false hZ
   398	  refine ⟨(f, h), ?_⟩
   399	  apply MvPolynomial.rename_injective (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
   400	    (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m).injective
   401	  apply (MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv (PauliScalar P) (Fin 2) (Fin (2 * P.m))).injective
   402	  change scalarPolynomial P g = _

   408	  simp only [hlin, MvPolynomial.coeff_add, MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul,
   409	    MvPolynomial.coeff_X, h01, Ne.symm h01, ↓reduceIte, mul_one, mul_zero,
   410	    add_zero, zero_add] at hf hh
   411	  change r = MvPolynomial.rename (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inl i)) f.1 at hf
   412	  change t = MvPolynomial.rename (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inr i)) h.1 at hh

     5	/-!
     6	# Indicator-weighted ordered projectors
     7	
     8	This module proves the local norm calculation in `eq:qld-g-prime`. The state
     9	vector is not assumed normalized: its squared norm controls the exceptional
    10	coefficient, so the estimate can be summed over all polynomial outcomes.
    11	The measurements act on an arbitrary finite space, which includes either
    12	player's placed expanded measurements.
    13	
    14	The coefficient-polynomial argument also bounds mass outside the scalar-linear
    15	image, with its actual ordered-correlation error displayed in the conclusion.
    16	These are auxiliary estimates, not the global polynomial-pair construction.
    17	The remaining block-separation and construction obligations are recorded in
    18	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex` and issue #513.
    19	
    20	Only the dependency chain needed for these estimates is exposed; supporting
    21	lemmas remain private.
    22	
    23	## References
    24	
    25	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1289-1326`,
    26	  especially `eq:qld-g-42`, `eq:qld-g-43`, and `eq:qld-g-prime`.
    27	-/

    43	/-- The ordered product selected by the linear field-answer check in
    44	`eq:qld-g-42`. This is an operator, not an asserted measurement effect. -/
    45	def orderedIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    46	  ∑ bc : F × F, if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    47	
    48	/-- The diagonal sandwich sum in `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
    49	def diagonalIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    50	  ∑ bc : F × F,
    51	    if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then
    52	      Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    53	
    54	/-- For a nonzero second coefficient, X orthogonality and cancellation in
    55	the field eliminate every off-diagonal term of the ordered Gram operator.
    56	This is the exact local algebra behind `eq:qld-g-prime`; no commutation of
    57	the X and Z measurements is assumed. -/
    58	private theorem orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    59	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    60	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a =
    61	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a := by
    62	  classical
    63	  unfold orderedIndicator diagonalIndicator
    64	  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    65	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun bc _ => ?_
    66	  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single bc]
    67	  · by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    68	    · simp only [if_pos h, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, measurement_effect_hermitian]
    69	      rw [mul_assoc (Z.effect bc.2), ← mul_assoc (X.effect bc.1),
    70	        (hX bc.1).isIdempotentElem.eq, ← mul_assoc]
    71	    · simp [h]
    72	  · intro bc' _ hne
    73	    by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    74	    · by_cases h' : α * bc'.1 + β * bc'.2 = a
    75	      · have hb : bc.1 ≠ bc'.1 := by
    76	          intro hb
    77	          have hc : bc.2 = bc'.2 := mul_left_cancel₀ hβ (by
    78	            apply add_left_cancel (a := α * bc.1)
    79	            simpa only [hb] using h.trans h'.symm)
    80	          exact hne (Prod.ext hb hc).symm
    81	        simp only [if_pos h, if_pos h', Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    82	          measurement_effect_hermitian]
    83	        calc
    84	          Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * (X.effect bc'.1 * Z.effect bc'.2) =
    85	              Z.effect bc.2 * (X.effect bc.1 * X.effect bc'.1) * Z.effect bc'.2 := by
    86	            simp only [mul_assoc]
    87	          _ = 0 := by rw [projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero X hX hb]; simp
    88	      · simp [h']
    89	    · simp [h]
    90	  · simp

    92	/-- The squared state norm of the ordered indicator equals its diagonal
    93	sandwich quadratic form when the second coefficient is nonzero. -/
    94	private theorem orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    95	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    96	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    97	    ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 =
    98	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) := by
    99	  rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq,
   100	    orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   101	  rfl

   103	/-- The diagonal indicator is a positive contraction, since it selects
   104	effects from the complete sandwich POVM. -/
   105	private theorem diagonalIndicator_bounds (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   106	    (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   107	    0 ≤ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ∧ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   108	  obtain ⟨hpos, hsum⟩ := pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ
   109	  change (∀ bc : F × F, 0 ≤ Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) at hpos
   110	  change (∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) = 1 at hsum
   111	  constructor
   112	  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun bc _ => by
   113	      split_ifs
   114	      · exact hpos bc
   115	      · exact le_refl 0
   116	  · calc
   117	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤
   118	          ∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 := by
   119	        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun bc _ => ?_
   120	        split_ifs
   121	        · exact le_refl _
   122	        · exact hpos bc
   123	      _ = 1 := hsum

   125	/-- At the exceptional coefficient zero, completeness of Z leaves a
   126	coarse-grained X projection. This includes zero first coefficient. -/
   127	private theorem orderedIndicator_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α a : F) :
   128	    orderedIndicator X Z α 0 a = (X.postprocess (fun b => α * b)).effect a := by
   129	  unfold orderedIndicator
   130	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
   131	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   132	  by_cases h : α * b = a
   133	  · simp only [zero_mul, add_zero, h, if_true]
   134	    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Z.sum_eq_one, mul_one]
   135	  · simp [h]

   137	/-- Every linear-answer ordered indicator is a contraction. For nonzero
   138	second coefficient this follows from the diagonal identity; at zero it
   139	follows from completeness and projective postprocessing. -/
   140	theorem orderedIndicator_gram_le_one (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   141	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   142	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   143	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   144	  · subst β
   145	    rw [orderedIndicator_zero, measurement_effect_hermitian,
   146	      (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective X hX (fun b => α * b) a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   147	    exact measurement_effect_le_one _ _
   148	  · rw [orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   149	    exact (diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a).2

   151	/-- The pointwise error in `eq:qld-g-prime` is supported on the zero second
   152	coefficient and bounded by the squared norm of the actual state vector. -/
   153	theorem abs_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_sub_diagonal_le (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   154	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   155	    (α β a : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   156	    |‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 -
   157	        stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a)| ≤
   158	      if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0 := by
   159	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   160	  · rw [if_pos hβ]
   161	    have hA0 := sq_nonneg ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖
   162	    have hA1 : ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   163	      rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, ← stateQForm_one ψ]
   164	      exact quadratic_form_mono (orderedIndicator_gram_le_one X Z hX hZ α β a) ψ
   165	    have hD := diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a
   166	    have hD0 := stateQForm_nonneg ψ hD.1
   167	    have hD1 : stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   168	      rw [← stateQForm_one ψ]
   169	      exact quadratic_form_mono hD.2 ψ
   170	    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
   171	  · rw [if_neg hβ, orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ ψ]
   172	    simp

   174	/-- Completeness and projectivity preserve total squared state mass. This is

   182	  change (∑ g : Γ, stateQForm ψ (S.effect g)) = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2

   185	/-- A polynomial not of the form `alpha * u + beta * v` has a nonzero
   186	coefficient outside those two monomials. Applied over the ring of base-point
   187	polynomials, this chooses one coefficient independently of both measurement
   188	outcomes in the argument following `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
   189	private theorem exists_nonzero_nonlinear_coeff {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
   190	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R)
   191	    (hp : ¬ ∃ u v : R, p = MvPolynomial.C u * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   192	      MvPolynomial.C v * MvPolynomial.X 1) :
   193	    ∃ e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, e ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1 ∧ e ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 ∧
   194	      p.coeff e ≠ 0 := by

   196	  have h01 : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := by
   197	    intro h
   198	    simpa using congrArg (fun e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => e 0) h
   199	  by_contra! h
   200	  apply hp
   201	  refine ⟨p.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 1), p.coeff (Finsupp.single 1 1), ?_⟩
   202	  ext e
   203	  by_cases h0 : e = Finsupp.single 0 1
   204	  · subst e
   205	    simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, Ne.symm h01]
   206	  · by_cases h1 : e = Finsupp.single 1 1
   207	    · subst e
   208	      simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, h01]
   209	    · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, Ne.symm h0, Ne.symm h1,

   212	omit [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] in
   213	/-- A nonzero specialized coefficient outside the scalar-linear monomials
   214	certifies nonzero difference from every `alpha * b + beta * c` simultaneously.
   215	This is the common good-base-point criterion needed before sandwich weighting. -/
   216	private theorem specialization_ne_linear_of_coeff {n : ℕ}
   217	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F)) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)
   218	    (he0 : e ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1) (he1 : e ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1)
   219	    (u : Fin n → F) (hu : MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) ≠ 0) (b c : F) :
   220	    MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p ≠
   221	      MvPolynomial.C b * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X 1 := by
   222	  intro h
   223	  apply hu
   224	  have hc := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff e) h
   225	  simpa [MvPolynomial.coeff_map, MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X,
   226	    Ne.symm he0, Ne.symm he1] using hc

   228	/-- Schwartz--Zippel in the uniform-average notation used by the coefficient
   229	and fiber calculations in `eq:qld-g-prime-bound` and `eq:qld-g-2`. -/
   230	theorem avg_eval_eq_le {n D : ℕ} (p r : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F)
   231	    (hne : p ≠ r) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ D) (hr : r.totalDegree ≤ D) :
   232	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))

    90	    (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    91	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
    92	      ‖applyOperatorToState ((1 - X.effect r) *
    93	        orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2) ≤
    94	      2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
    95	  classical
    96	  let w (bc : F × F) := stateQForm ψ
    97	    (Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2)
    98	  have hw (bc : F × F) : 0 ≤ w bc :=
    99	    stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).1 bc)
   100	  have hsum : ∑ bc, w bc = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   101	    rw [← stateQForm_one ψ, ← (pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).2,
   102	      stateQForm_finset_sum]
   103	    rfl
   104	  have hpoint (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   105	      ‖applyOperatorToState ((1 - X.effect r) *
   106	        orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   107	      (if v 1 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) + ∑ bc : F × F,
   108	        (if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t ∧ bc.1 ≠ r
   109	          then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   110	    by_cases hv : v 1 = 0
   111	    · rw [if_pos hv]
   112	      apply le_trans (b := ‖ψ‖ ^ 2)
   113	      · apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
   114	        rw [applyOperatorToState_mul]
   115	        exact (MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_le
   116	          (MagicSquareRigidity.conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (hX r).one_sub) _).trans
   117	          (MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_le
   118	            (orderedIndicator_gram_le_one X Z hX hZ _ _ _) ψ)
   119	      · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg fun bc _ =>
   120	          mul_nonneg (by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (hw bc))
   121	    · rw [if_neg hv, zero_add, MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq]
   122	      change stateQForm ψ _ ≤ _
   123	      rw [wrong_ordered_gram X Z hX r _ _ _ hv, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   124	      apply le_of_eq
   125	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   126	      intro bc _
   127	      split_ifs <;> simp [w, stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
   128	  have hexc : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   129	      (fun v => if v 1 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) =
   130	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   131	    change avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   132	      (fun v => if ((finTwoArrowEquiv F) v).2 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) = _
   133	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   134	    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   135	    rw [avgOver_uniform_snd (fun β : F => if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0)]
   136	    simp [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]
   137	  have hcollision (bc : F × F) :
   138	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   139	        if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t ∧ bc.1 ≠ r
   140	          then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
   141	    by_cases hb : bc.1 = r
   142	    · simp [hb, avgOver_uniform_const]
   143	    · rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   144	      have h := affine_collision_average bc (r, t)
   145	      have hne : bc ≠ (r, t) := fun h => hb (congrArg Prod.fst h)
   146	      simpa [finTwoArrowEquiv, hb, hne] using h.le
   147	  have h := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) _ _ hpoint
   148	  simp only [avgOver_add, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const, hexc] at h
   149	  refine h.trans ?_
   150	  have hc := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) fun bc _ =>
   151	    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcollision bc) (hw bc)
   152	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hsum] at hc
   153	  linarith
   154	
   155	/-- Point mismatch on a retained polynomial is at most twice its ordered
   156	residual plus `4/q` times its unnormalized mass. Reverse the point order to
   157	obtain the other Pauli marginal. This supports `eq:qld-sgg-mhat-sandwich`.
   158	-/
   159	theorem point_mismatch_le_ordered_error (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   160	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   161	    (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   162	    ‖applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   163	      2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   164	        ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState
   165	          (orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2) +
   166	      4 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   167	  have hpoint (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   168	      ‖applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   169	        2 * ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState
   170	          (orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   171	        2 * ‖applyOperatorToState ((1 - X.effect r) *
   172	          orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   173	    let T := orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)
   174	    have h := sum_mass_le_residual_add_image (Finset.univ : Finset Unit)
   175	      (fun _ => applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) ψ)
   176	      (fun _ => applyOperatorToState ((1 - X.effect r) * T) ψ)
   177	    simp only [Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton] at h
   178	    have hcontract :
   179	        ‖applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) ψ -
   180	          applyOperatorToState ((1 - X.effect r) * T) ψ‖ ≤
   181	        ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState T ψ‖ := by
   182	      rw [applyOperatorToState_mul]
   183	      have heq : applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) ψ -
   184	          applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) (applyOperatorToState T ψ) =
   185	          applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) (ψ - applyOperatorToState T ψ) := by
   186	        simp only [applyOperatorToState, map_sub]
   187	      rw [heq]
   188	      exact MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_le
   189	        (MagicSquareRigidity.conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (hX r).one_sub) _
   190	    exact h.trans (add_le_add
   191	      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hcontract 2)
   192	        (by norm_num)) le_rfl)
   193	  have h := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) _ _ hpoint
   194	  simp only [avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_add, avgOver_const_mul] at h
   195	  have hm := avg_wrong_ordered_norm_sq_le X Z hX hZ r t ψ
   196	  linarith
   197	
   198	end

     4	/-!
     5	# Common exceptional fibers for polynomial coefficients
     6	
     7	A nonconstant polynomial in one block, with polynomial coefficients in a
     8	second block, has a nonzero coefficient at a nonconstant monomial. Its zero set controls
     9	all exceptional specializations simultaneously, independently of the outcome
    10	of a measurement. The weights may depend on the fixed block but not on the
    11	block being averaged.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1341-1358`,
    16	especially `eq:qld-g-2`; support for blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolynomialImageBounds
    22

    24	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus

    28	variable {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]

    30	private theorem exists_nonconstant_coeff {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ}
    31	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r) :
    32	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
    33	  classical
    34	  by_contra! h
    35	  apply hp
    36	  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
    37	  ext e
    38	  by_cases he : e = 0
    39	  · simp [he]
    40	  · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he, h e he]
    41	
    42	/-- A single coefficient defines the exceptional slices for every field
    43	outcome. Outside its zero set, every fiber has probability at most `D/q`;
    44	the exceptional set itself has probability at most `C/q`. Both degree
    45	conditions concern the displayed polynomial, not an assumed collision law.
    46	This is the common-set argument following `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting
    47	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    48	theorem exists_common_exceptional_coefficient {n k C D : ℕ}
    49	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    50	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    51	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D) :
    52	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 ∧
    53	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F))
    54	        (fun z => if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
    55	          (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F ∧
    56	      ∀ z : Fin k → F, MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) ≠ 0 → ∀ b : F,
    57	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    58	          (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    59	            then 1 else 0) ≤ (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F := by
    60	  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := exists_nonconstant_coeff p hp
    61	  refine ⟨e, he, hc, ?_, ?_⟩
    62	  · simpa using avg_eval_eq_le (p.coeff e) 0 hc (hcoeff e) (by simp)
    63	  · intro z hz b
    64	    have hne : MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p ≠ MvPolynomial.C b := by
    65	      intro h
    66	      apply hz
    67	      have h' := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff e) h
    68	      simpa [MvPolynomial.coeff_map, MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he] using h'
    69	    have hd : (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p).totalDegree ≤ D :=
    70	      (Finset.sup_mono (MvPolynomial.support_map_subset _ _)).trans hdegree
    71	    simpa using avg_eval_eq_le _ (MvPolynomial.C b) hne hd (by simp)
    72	
    73	/-- Summing all nonnegative outcome weights before averaging exceptional
    74	slices avoids an outcome-cardinality factor. The weights may depend on `z`
    75	and their sum is the same mass `M` at every `z`. This is the weighted fiber
    76	calculation in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    77	theorem avg_weighted_fiber_le {n k C D : ℕ}
    78	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    79	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    80	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D)
    81	    (w : (Fin k → F) → F → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    82	    (hw : ∀ z b, 0 ≤ w z b) (hsum : ∀ z, ∑ b, w z b = M) :
    83	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z => ∑ b : F,
    84	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    85	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    86	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤ ((C + D : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    87	  classical
    88	  obtain ⟨e, _, _, hbad, hgood⟩ :=
    89	    exists_common_exceptional_coefficient p hp hcoeff hdegree
    90	  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by
    91	    rw [← hsum (fun _ => 0)]
    92	    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => hw _ b
    93	  have hpoint (z : Fin k → F) :
    94	      (∑ b : F, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    95	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    96	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤
    97	      (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
    98	        (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    99	    by_cases hz : MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0
   100	    · simp only [hz, if_true, one_mul]
   101	      apply le_trans (b := M)
   102	      · rw [← hsum z]
   103	        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   104	        intro b _
   105	        apply le_trans (b := 1 * w z b)
   106	        · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hw z b)
   107	          apply avgOver_uniform_le_const
   108	          intro x
   109	          split_ifs <;> norm_num
   110	        · rw [one_mul]
   111	      · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hM)
   112	    · simp only [hz, if_false, zero_mul, zero_add]
   113	      rw [← hsum z, Finset.mul_sum]
   114	      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ =>
   115	        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgood z hz b) (hw z b)
   116	  calc
   117	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   118	        (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
   119	          (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M) := avgOver_mono _ _ _ hpoint
   120	    _ ≤ (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M + (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
   121	      rw [avgOver_add, avgOver_mul_const, avgOver_uniform_const]
   122	      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbad hM) le_rfl
   123	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring
   124

   127	private theorem avg_diagonalIndicator_linear_le
   128	    (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   129	    (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   130	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   131	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t))) ≤
   132	      (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   133	        stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t * X.effect r * Z.effect t) := by
   134	  classical
   135	  let w (bc : F × F) : ℝ := stateQForm ψ
   136	    (Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2)
   137	  have hw (bc : F × F) : 0 ≤ w bc :=
   138	    stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).1 bc)
   139	  have hsum : ∑ bc, w bc = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   140	    rw [← stateQForm_one ψ, ← (pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).2,
   141	      stateQForm_finset_sum]
   142	    rfl
   143	  have hexpand (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   144	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) =
   145	      ∑ bc : F × F, (if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t
   146	        then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   147	    rw [diagonalIndicator, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   148	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   149	    intro bc _
   150	    split_ifs <;> simp [w, stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
   151	  have hcollision (bc : F × F) :
   152	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   153	        if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
   154	        if bc = (r, t) then 1 else (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
   155	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   156	    exact affine_collision_average bc (r, t)
   157	  simp_rw [hexpand, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const, hcollision]
   158	  calc
   159	    _ ≤ ∑ bc : F × F, ((Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ +
   160	        if bc = (r, t) then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   161	      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   162	      intro bc _
   163	      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hw bc)
   164	      split_ifs <;> simp
   165	    _ = _ := by
   166	      simp_rw [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   167	      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hsum]
   168	      simp [w]

   170	private theorem avg_orderedIndicator_linear_le
   171	    (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X)
   172	    (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   173	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   174	      ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1)
   175	        (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2) ≤
   176	      2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 + stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t) := by
   177	  have hexc : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   178	      (fun v => if v 1 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) =
   179	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   180	    change avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   181	      (fun v => if ((finTwoArrowEquiv F) v).2 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) = _
   182	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   183	    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   184	    rw [avgOver_uniform_snd (fun β : F => if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0)]
   185	    simp [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]
   186	  have hdrop : stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t * X.effect r * Z.effect t) ≤
   187	      stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t) := by
   188	    apply quadratic_form_mono
   189	    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, measurement_effect_hermitian, mul_one,
   190	      (hZ t).isIdempotentElem.eq] using
   191	      star_left_conjugate_le_conjugate (measurement_effect_le_one X r) (Z.effect t)
   192	  have havg := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) _ _ (fun v =>
   193	    le_trans (le_abs_self _) (abs_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_sub_diagonal_le
   194	      X Z hX hZ (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t) ψ))
   195	  rw [avgOver_sub, hexc] at havg
   196	  have hdiag := avg_diagonalIndicator_linear_le X Z hZ r t ψ
   197	  linarith
   198	
   199	/-- The wrong-variable coefficient is concentrated only after the middle
   200	contraction has been removed. The outer measurement depends solely on the
   201	fixed block `z`; `X` depends solely on the varying block `x`. For the other
   202	class interchange `X,Z` and the two blocks. The vector is arbitrary and
   203	need not be normalized. This proves the local norm bound behind
   204	`eq:qld-g-prime-xpt-bound` and its reversed-order counterpart, supporting
   205	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   206	theorem avg_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_nonconstant {n k C D : ℕ}
   207	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
   208	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
   209	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D)
   210	    (r : (Fin n → F) → (Fin k → F) → F)
   211	    (X : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   212	    (Z : (Fin k → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   213	    (hX : ∀ x, Measurement.IsProjective (X x))
   214	    (hZ : ∀ z, Measurement.IsProjective (Z z)) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   215	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   216	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun x =>
   217	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   218	          ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X x) (Z z) (v 0) (v 1)
   219	            (v 0 * r x z + v 1 *
   220	              MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))) ψ‖ ^ 2))) ≤
   221	      ((C + D + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   222	  classical
   223	  let w (z : Fin k → F) (b : F) := stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect b)
   224	  have hsum (z : Fin k → F) : ∑ b, w z b = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   225	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, (Z z).sum_eq_one, stateQForm_one]
   226	  have hfiber := avg_weighted_fiber_le p hp hcoeff hdegree w (‖ψ‖ ^ 2)
   227	    (fun z b => stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((Z z).pos b)) hsum
   228	  have heval (z : Fin k → F) (x : Fin n → F) :
   229	      stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect
   230	        (MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))) =
   231	      ∑ b : F, (if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
   232	        then 1 else 0) * w z b := by
   233	    simp [w]
   234	  calc
   235	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   236	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun x =>
   237	          2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   238	          stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect
   239	            (MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))))) := by
   240	      apply avgOver_mono
   241	      intro z
   242	      apply avgOver_mono
   243	      intro x
   244	      exact avg_orderedIndicator_linear_le (X x) (Z z) (hX x) (hZ z) _ _ ψ

   143	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
   144	            ∑ g, ‖ψ g - A z x v g‖ ^ 2))) =

   187	/-- The actual rounded measurements satisfy both wrong-variable mass bounds,
   188	with both player placements and both ordered estimates preserved. The scalar
   189	nonlinear estimate is retained for the union of the three unwanted classes.
   190	All errors are the errors of direct soundness and rounding, including the

   195	the retained point overlaps or the global-pair witness. -/
   196	theorem exists_rounded_polynomial_wrong_variable_mass :
   197	    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
   198	      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε δQ δL : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   199	        (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ) (_lines : ExtendedLinesWitness S points δL),
   200	      let delta := deltaLd a b
   201	        (directPassingErrorEnvelope (δQ + δL) ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q))
   202	        P.q (2 * P.m + 2) P.d 1
   203	      let eta := delta + Real.sqrt (220 * Real.rpow delta (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
   204	        2 * Real.sqrt (2 * delta)
   205	      ∃ RA : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice),
   206	      ∃ RB : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob),
   207	        Measurement.IsProjective RA ∧ Measurement.IsProjective RB ∧
   208	        (∀ reverse : Bool,
   209	          extendedPolynomialOrderedError S .AA' .BA'' RA reverse ≤ 4 * eta + 8 * δQ ∧
   210	          extendedPolynomialOrderedError S .BB' .AB'' RB reverse ≤ 4 * eta + 8 * δQ) ∧
   211	        scalarNonlinearMass S .AA' RA ≤ 2 * (4 * eta + 8 * δQ) +
   212	          2 * (((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q ∧
   213	        scalarNonlinearMass S .BB' RB ≤ 2 * (4 * eta + 8 * δQ) +
   214	          2 * (((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q ∧
   215	        (∀ reverse : Bool,
   216	          scalarWrongVariableMass S .AA' RA reverse ≤ 2 * (4 * eta + 8 * δQ) +
   217	            2 * (((P.m * P.d + P.m * P.d + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) ∧
   218	          scalarWrongVariableMass S .BB' RB reverse ≤ 2 * (4 * eta + 8 * δQ) +
   219	            2 * (((P.m * P.d + P.m * P.d + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q)) := by
   220	  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, h⟩ := exists_rounded_polynomial_scalar_mass
   221	  refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, ?_⟩
   222	  intro P ε δQ δL S points lines delta eta
   223	  obtain ⟨RA, RB, hRA, hRB, horder, hNA, hNB⟩ := h P ε δQ δL S points lines
   224	  refine ⟨RA, RB, hRA, hRB, horder, hNA, hNB, ?_⟩
   225	  intro reverse
   226	  constructor
   227	  · exact (scalarWrongVariableMass_le_ordered_error S .AA' .BA''
   228	      (by trivial) RA hRA reverse).trans (add_le_add
   229	        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (horder reverse).1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)) le_rfl)
   230	  · exact (scalarWrongVariableMass_le_ordered_error S .BB' .AB''
   231	      (by trivial) RB hRB reverse).trans (add_le_add
   232	        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (horder reverse).2 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)) le_rfl)

   234	/-- Mass outside the existing bounded polynomial-pair combining image after

   236	`eq:qld-g-non-separable` and `def:combine-map`, supporting blueprint
   237	`lem:qld-4-7`; no completion or overlap assertion is included. -/
   238	def separatedPolynomialMass {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   239	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
   240	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) : ℝ := by
   241	  classical
   242	  exact ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g => ¬ ∃ pair : PolyPair P,
   243	      MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1 =
   244	        combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1),
   245	    ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p (R.effect g)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2

   247	private theorem separatedPolynomialMass_le_three_masses {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   248	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
   249	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
   250	    separatedPolynomialMass S p R ≤ scalarNonlinearMass S p R +
   251	      scalarWrongVariableMass S p R false + scalarWrongVariableMass S p R true := by
   252	  classical
   253	  simp only [separatedPolynomialMass, scalarNonlinearMass, scalarWrongVariableMass,
   254	    Finset.sum_filter, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
   255	  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   256	  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   257	  intro g _
   258	  by_cases hlin : ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P),
   259	      scalarPolynomial P g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   260	        MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1
   261	  · by_cases hX : ∃ r, blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single 0 1) true =
   262	        MvPolynomial.C r
   263	    · by_cases hZ : ∃ r, blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single 1 1) false =
   264	          MvPolynomial.C r
   265	      · have himage := exists_polyPair_of_scalar_separated P g hlin hX hZ
   266	        simp only [hlin, hX, hZ, not_true_eq_false, and_false, ↓reduceIte, zero_add]
   267	        split_ifs with hout
   268	        · exact le_rfl
   269	        · exact False.elim (hout himage)
   270	      · simp only [hlin, hX, hZ, not_false_eq_true, not_true_eq_false, and_true,
   271	          and_false, ↓reduceIte, zero_add, add_zero]
   272	        split_ifs <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p (R.effect g)) S.psiHat‖]
   273	    · simp only [hlin, hX, not_false_eq_true, not_true_eq_false, true_and, ↓reduceIte,
   274	        zero_add]
   275	      split_ifs <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p (R.effect g)) S.psiHat‖]
   276	  · simp only [hlin, not_false_eq_true, false_and, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
   277	    split_ifs <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p (R.effect g)) S.psiHat‖]
   278	
   279	/-- The union of the three excluded classes is bounded in the actual two
   280	ordered errors. The image is the existing faithful `combinePoly` encoding
   281	with both components in `Poly P`. This proves concentration only, as in
   282	`eq:qld-g-non-separable`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   283	theorem separatedPolynomialMass_le_ordered_errors {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   284	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
   285	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
   286	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) :
   287	    separatedPolynomialMass S p1 R ≤
   288	      4 * extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R false +
   289	      2 * extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R true +
   290	      (((12 * P.m * P.d + 4 * P.d + 10 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) := by
   291	  have h := separatedPolynomialMass_le_three_masses S p1 R
   292	  have hN := scalarNonlinearMass_le_ordered_error S p1 p2 hopposite R hR
   293	  have hX := scalarWrongVariableMass_le_ordered_error S p1 p2 hopposite R hR true
   294	  have hZ := scalarWrongVariableMass_le_ordered_error S p1 p2 hopposite R hR false
   295	  refine h.trans ((add_le_add (add_le_add hN hZ) hX).trans_eq ?_)
   296	  push_cast
   297	  ring

   299	/-- Both actual rounded measurements concentrate on faithful separated
   300	polynomial pairs, with error `6E + (12md + 4d + 10)/q` and
   301	`E = 4eta + 8deltaQ`. The same measurements retain both ordered estimates.

   304	domain restriction. This proves `eq:qld-g-non-separable`, supporting
   305	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`, without claiming the subsequent retained overlaps
   306	or the source global-pair witness. -/
   307	theorem exists_rounded_polynomial_separated_mass :
   308	    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
   309	      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε δQ δL : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   310	        (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ) (_lines : ExtendedLinesWitness S points δL),
   311	      let delta := deltaLd a b
   312	        (directPassingErrorEnvelope (δQ + δL) ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q))
   313	        P.q (2 * P.m + 2) P.d 1
   314	      let eta := delta + Real.sqrt (220 * Real.rpow delta (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
   315	        2 * Real.sqrt (2 * delta)
   316	      ∃ RA : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice),
   317	      ∃ RB : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob),
   318	        Measurement.IsProjective RA ∧ Measurement.IsProjective RB ∧
   319	        (∀ reverse : Bool,
   320	          extendedPolynomialOrderedError S .AA' .BA'' RA reverse ≤ 4 * eta + 8 * δQ ∧
   321	          extendedPolynomialOrderedError S .BB' .AB'' RB reverse ≤ 4 * eta + 8 * δQ) ∧

   325	          (((12 * P.m * P.d + 4 * P.d + 10 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) := by
   326	  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, h⟩ := exists_rounded_polynomial_ordered_estimates
   327	  refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, ?_⟩
   328	  intro P ε δQ δL S points lines delta eta
   329	  obtain ⟨RA, RB, hRA, hRB, horder⟩ := h P ε δQ δL S points lines

   331	  · have hA := separatedPolynomialMass_le_ordered_errors S .AA' .BA'' (by trivial) RA hRA
   332	    have h0 := (horder false).1
   333	    have h1 := (horder true).1
   334	    linarith

   336	    have h0 := (horder false).2
   337	    have h1 := (horder true).2

    26	private theorem map_mem_polyFunc {K L : Type*} [CommSemiring K] [CommSemiring L]
    27	    {n d : ℕ} (e : K →+* L) (p : Preliminaries.polyFunc n K d) :
    28	    MvPolynomial.map e p.1 ∈ Preliminaries.polyFunc n L d := by
    29	  rw [MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree]
    30	  intro s hs i
    31	  exact (MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree _ _ _).mp p.2 s
    32	    (MvPolynomial.support_map_subset e p.1 hs) i
    33	
    34	/-- Exact singleton and coefficient-field equivalence for the actual rounded
    35	outcomes. The degree certificates are transported through support inclusion. -/
    36	def directPolynomialEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    37	    DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd ≃
    38	      Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d where
    39	  toFun g := ⟨MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1,
    40	    map_mem_polyFunc _ _⟩
    41	  invFun p := fun _ => ⟨MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm.toRingHom p.1,
    42	    map_mem_polyFunc _ _⟩
    43	  left_inv g := by
    44	    funext i
    45	    have hi : i = (0 : Fin 1) := @Subsingleton.elim (Fin 1) _ i 0
    46	    subst i
    47	    apply Subtype.ext
    48	    exact (MvPolynomial.mapEquiv _ (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P)).symm_apply_apply _
    49	  right_inv p := by
    50	    apply Subtype.ext
    51	    exact (MvPolynomial.mapEquiv _ (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P)).apply_symm_apply _
    52	
    53	/-- The actual singleton outcome corresponding to a bounded polynomial pair. -/
    54	def directCombinedEmbedding (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    55	    PolyPair P ↪ DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd :=
    56	  (combinedPolyEmbedding P).trans (directPolynomialEquiv P).symm.toEmbedding
    57	
    58	/-- Relabel the actual rounded measurement in the canonical coefficient field. -/
    59	def canonicalPolynomialMeasurement {P : AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
    60	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd ι) :
    61	    Quantum.Measurement (Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) ι :=
    62	  R.postprocess (directPolynomialEquiv P)
    63	
    64	/-- The canonical relabeling retains each original effect exactly. -/
    65	@[simp] theorem canonicalPolynomialMeasurement_effect {P : AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
    66	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd ι)
    67	    (p : Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) :
    68	    (canonicalPolynomialMeasurement R).effect p =
    69	      R.effect ((directPolynomialEquiv P).symm p) := by
    70	  have h := SandwichProduct.postprocess_effect_of_injective R (directPolynomialEquiv P)
    71	    (directPolynomialEquiv P).injective ((directPolynomialEquiv P).symm p)
    72	  simpa only [canonicalPolynomialMeasurement, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using h
    73	
    74	/-- The complete projective pair construction applied to the actual
    75	rounded measurement, including all excluded outcomes at one chosen pair. -/
    76	def directPairMeasurement {P : AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
    77	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd ι)
    78	    (pair₀ : PolyPair P) : Quantum.Measurement (PolyPair P) ι :=
    79	  completedPairMeasurement P (canonicalPolynomialMeasurement R) pair₀
    80	
    81	/-- Projectivity follows from completion and injective field transport. -/
    82	theorem directPairMeasurement_projective {P : AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
    83	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd ι)
    84	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) (pair₀ : PolyPair P) :
    85	    Measurement.IsProjective (directPairMeasurement R pair₀) :=
    86	  completedPairMeasurement_projective P _
    87	    (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective R hR _) pair₀
    88	
    89	/-- The faithful image predicate is exactly membership in the actual pair embedding. -/
    90	theorem mem_range_directCombinedEmbedding (P : AdmissibleParams)
    91	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
    92	    g ∈ Set.range (directCombinedEmbedding P) ↔
    93	      ∃ pair : PolyPair P,
    94	        MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1 =
    95	          combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1 := by
    96	  constructor
    97	  · rintro ⟨pair, rfl⟩
    98	    refine ⟨pair, ?_⟩
    99	    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((directPolynomialEquiv P).apply_symm_apply
   100	      (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair))
   101	  · rintro ⟨pair, hp⟩
   102	    refine ⟨pair, ?_⟩
   103	    apply (directPolynomialEquiv P).injective
   104	    exact ((directPolynomialEquiv P).apply_symm_apply _).trans (Subtype.ext hp.symm)
   105	
   106	/-- Evaluation of the actual retained outcome is the prescribed affine
   107	combination, with the original joint sample and canonical field transport. -/
   108	theorem directCombinedEmbedding_read (P : AdmissibleParams)
   109	    (x : ExtendedPointQuestion P) (pair : PolyPair P) :
   110	    extendedPolynomialRead P x (directCombinedEmbedding P pair) =
   111	      x.2.1 * evalAt .X x.1.1 pair + x.2.2 * evalAt .Z x.1.2 pair := by
   112	  let u := (directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv P).symm x
   113	  have hx := directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv_apply P u
   114	  have heval : extendedPolynomialRead P x (directCombinedEmbedding P pair) =
   115	      MvPolynomial.eval (directPointToPauli P u) (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair).1 := by
   116	    let p : Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) P.d :=
   117	      directCombinedEmbedding P pair (0 : Fin 1)
   118	    have hp := congrArg Subtype.val ((directPolynomialEquiv P).apply_symm_apply
   119	      (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair))
   120	    change MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom p.1 = _ at hp
   121	    rw [← hp]
   122	    change extendedDirectScalarEquiv P (MvPolynomial.eval u p.1) = _
   123	    rw [MvPolynomial.eval_map]
   124	    exact (MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom u p.1).symm
   125	  rw [heval, combinedPolyEmbedding_eval]
   126	  have hx' : x = ((projX (directPointToPauli P u), projZ (directPointToPauli P u)),
   127	      (directPointToPauli P u (alphaVar P.m), directPointToPauli P u (betaVar P.m))) :=
   128	    ((directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv P).apply_symm_apply x).symm.trans hx
   129	  rw [hx']
   130

    26	/-- The retained point mismatch is the squared norm of the incorrect point
    27	projection on the actual vector `R_g psiHat`, averaged over the point. -/
    28	def retainedPointMismatch {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    29	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : Placement)
    30	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    31	    (W : PauliKind) : ℝ :=
    32	  avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun x =>
    33	    ∑ pair : PolyPair P, ‖applyOperatorToState
    34	      (1 - S.place p2 ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side W x).effect (evalAt W x pair)))
    35	      (applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 (R.effect (directCombinedEmbedding P pair)))
    36	        S.psiHat)‖ ^ 2)
    37	
    38	/-- Both retained point mismatches are bounded by their appropriate full
    39	ordered error. The wrong point projection is the outer factor: `XZ` for X,
    40	`ZX` for Z. Normalization is used only after summing the actual vector masses,
    41	so there is no outcome-cardinality factor. -/
    42	theorem retainedPointMismatch_le_ordered_error {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    43	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
    44	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    45	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) (reverse : Bool) :
    46	    retainedPointMismatch S p1 p2 R (if reverse then .Z else .X) ≤
    47	      2 * extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R reverse + 4 / P.q := by
    48	  classical
    49	  let ψ := fun g => applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 (R.effect g)) S.psiHat
    50	  let X := fun x : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P => S.placedMeasurement p2
    51	    (S.pointMeasExp p2.side (if reverse then .Z else .X) x)
    52	  let Z := fun z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P => S.placedMeasurement p2
    53	    (S.pointMeasExp p2.side (if reverse then .X else .Z) z)
    54	  let A := fun (z x : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) g =>
    55	    applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X x) (Z z) (v 0) (v 1)
    56	      (extendedPolynomialRead P (fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v)) g)) (ψ g)
    57	  have hmass : ∑ g, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    58	    simpa only [ψ, ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect, S.psiHat_norm, one_pow] using
    59	      sum_projective_state_norm_sq (S.placedMeasurement p1 R)
    60	        (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p1 R hR) S.psiHat
    61	  have hretained : ∑ pair, ‖ψ (directCombinedEmbedding P pair)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    62	    rw [← hmass, ← Finset.sum_image (f := fun g => ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2) (fun a _ b _ h =>
    63	      (directCombinedEmbedding P).injective h)]
    64	    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (by
    65	      intros; exact sq_nonneg _)
    66	  have hread (z x : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)
    67	      (pair : PolyPair P) :
    68	      extendedPolynomialRead P (fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v))
    69	        (directCombinedEmbedding P pair) =
    70	      v 0 * evalAt (if reverse then .Z else .X) x pair +
    71	        v 1 * evalAt (if reverse then .X else .Z) z pair := by
    72	    rw [directCombinedEmbedding_read]
    73	    cases reverse <;> simp [fiberQuestionEquiv, finTwoArrowEquiv, add_comm]
    74	  have hpoint (z x : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    75	      (∑ pair : PolyPair P, ‖applyOperatorToState
    76	        (1 - (X x).effect (evalAt (if reverse then .Z else .X) x pair))
    77	          (ψ (directCombinedEmbedding P pair))‖ ^ 2) ≤
    78	      2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
    79	        ∑ g, ‖ψ g - A z x v g‖ ^ 2) + 4 / P.q := by
    80	    have h (pair : PolyPair P) := point_mismatch_le_ordered_error (X x) (Z z)
    81	      (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p2 _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _))
    82	      (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p2 _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _))
    83	      (evalAt (if reverse then .Z else .X) x pair)
    84	      (evalAt (if reverse then .X else .Z) z pair) (ψ (directCombinedEmbedding P pair))
    85	    simp_rw [← hread z x] at h
    86	    have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun pair _ => h pair)
    87	    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← avgOver_sum] at hs
    88	    have herr : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
    89	        ∑ pair, ‖ψ (directCombinedEmbedding P pair) -
    90	          A z x v (directCombinedEmbedding P pair)‖ ^ 2) ≤
    91	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
    92	        ∑ g, ‖ψ g - A z x v g‖ ^ 2) := by
    93	      apply avgOver_mono
    94	      intro v
    95	      rw [← Finset.sum_image (f := fun g => ‖ψ g - A z x v g‖ ^ 2)
    96	        (fun a _ b _ h => (directCombinedEmbedding P).injective h)]
    97	      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (by
    98	        intros; exact sq_nonneg _)
    99	    have hcard : Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) = P.q :=
   100	      @FieldModel.card P.q P.model.toFieldModel
   101	    have hc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hretained
   102	      (show 0 ≤ 4 * (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℝ)⁻¹ by positivity)
   103	    rw [hcard, mul_one] at hc
   104	    change _ ≤ 2 * _ + 4 * (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℝ)⁻¹ * _ at hs
   105	    rw [hcard] at hs
   106	    change _ ≤ 2 * avgOver _ (fun v => ∑ pair,
   107	      ‖ψ (directCombinedEmbedding P pair) - A z x v (directCombinedEmbedding P pair)‖ ^ 2) +
   108	      4 * (P.q : ℝ)⁻¹ * _ at hs
   109	    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
   110	    linarith
   111	  have hfull :
   112	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun z =>
   113	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun x =>
   114	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
   115	            ∑ g, ‖ψ g - A z x v g‖ ^ 2))) =
   116	        extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R reverse := by
   117	    rw [← avgOver_uniform_prod (fun z x =>
   118	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
   119	        ∑ g, ‖ψ g - A z x v g‖ ^ 2))]
   120	    rw [← avgOver_uniform_prod
   121	      (fun zx : (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) =>
   122	        fun v => ∑ g, ‖ψ g - A zx.1 zx.2 v g‖ ^ 2)]
   123	    unfold extendedPolynomialOrderedError
   124	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse).symm]
   125	    apply avgOver_congr
   126	    rintro ⟨⟨z, x⟩, v⟩
   127	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   128	    intro g _
   129	    dsimp only [A, X, Z]
   130	    rw [placed_fiber_orderedIndicator]
   131	    dsimp only [ψ]
   132	    rw [placed_residual S p1 p2 hopposite]
   133	    rfl
   134	  have h := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) _ _ fun z =>
   135	    avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) _ _ (hpoint z)
   136	  simp only [avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_add, avgOver_const_mul, hfull] at h
   137	  exact h
   138	
   139	end

    27	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
    28	    (A B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
    29	    S.place p (A + B) = S.place p A + S.place p B := by

    33	/-- The retained diagonal overlap with the actual opposite point measurement. -/
    34	def retainedPointOverlap {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    35	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : Placement)
    36	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    37	    (W : PauliKind) : ℝ :=
    38	  avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun x =>
    39	    ∑ pair : PolyPair P, stateQForm S.psiHat
    40	      (S.place p1 (R.effect (directCombinedEmbedding P pair)) *
    41	        S.place p2 ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side W x).effect (evalAt W x pair))))

    43	private theorem retained_mass_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    44	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
    45	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side))
    46	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) :
    47	    (∑ pair : PolyPair P,
    48	      ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p (R.effect (directCombinedEmbedding P pair)))
    49	        S.psiHat‖ ^ 2) = 1 - separatedPolynomialMass S p R := by
    50	  classical
    51	  let w := fun g => ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p (R.effect g)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2
    52	  have hmass : ∑ g, w g = 1 := by
    53	    simpa only [w, ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect, S.psiHat_norm, one_pow] using
    54	      sum_projective_state_norm_sq (S.placedMeasurement p R)
    55	        (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p R hR) S.psiHat
    56	  have hgood : Finset.univ.image (directCombinedEmbedding P) =
    57	      Finset.univ.filter (fun g => ∃ pair : PolyPair P,
    58	        MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1 =
    59	          combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1) := by
    60	    ext g
    61	    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_filter]
    62	    exact mem_range_directCombinedEmbedding P g
    63	  change (∑ pair, w (directCombinedEmbedding P pair)) = _
    64	  rw [← Finset.sum_image (f := w) (fun a _ b _ h =>
    65	    (directCombinedEmbedding P).injective h), hgood]
    66	  have hsplit := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ
    67	    (fun g => ∃ pair : PolyPair P,
    68	      MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1 =
    69	        combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1) w
    70	  rw [hmass] at hsplit
    71	  exact eq_sub_of_add_eq hsplit

    73	/-- Retained mass splits exactly into point overlap and point mismatch.
    74	This is the normalized good/bad identity of `eq:qld-s-good-and-bad`; the
    75	individual projected vectors in its proof remain unnormalized. -/
    76	theorem retainedPointMismatch_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    77	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
    78	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    79	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) (W : PauliKind) :
    80	    retainedPointMismatch S p1 p2 R W =
    81	      1 - separatedPolynomialMass S p1 R - retainedPointOverlap S p1 p2 R W := by
    82	  have hpoint (x : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (pair : PolyPair P) :
    83	      ‖applyOperatorToState
    84	        (1 - S.place p2 ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side W x).effect (evalAt W x pair)))
    85	        (applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 (R.effect (directCombinedEmbedding P pair)))
    86	          S.psiHat)‖ ^ 2 =
    87	      ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 (R.effect (directCombinedEmbedding P pair)))
    88	        S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 - stateQForm S.psiHat
    89	          (S.place p1 (R.effect (directCombinedEmbedding P pair)) *
    90	            S.place p2 ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side W x).effect (evalAt W x pair))) := by
    91	    have hM := S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p2 _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ W x)
    92	      (evalAt W x pair)
    93	    have hG := S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p1 R hR (directCombinedEmbedding P pair)
    94	    simp only [ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect] at hM hG
    95	    have hcomm := S.place_comm p1 p2 hopposite
    96	      (R.effect (directCombinedEmbedding P pair))
    97	      ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side W x).effect (evalAt W x pair))
    98	    rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq]
    99	    change stateQForm _ _ = _
   100	    have hsub (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
   101	        (A B : Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   102	        stateQForm ψ (A - B) = stateQForm ψ A - stateQForm ψ B := by
   103	      simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
   104	    rw [hM.one_sub.isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq, hM.one_sub.isIdempotentElem.eq,
   105	      hsub, stateQForm_one,
   106	      stateQForm_applyOperatorToState_eq_of_isProj S.psiHat hG hcomm.symm, hcomm]
   107	  unfold retainedPointMismatch retainedPointOverlap
   108	  simp_rw [hpoint, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, avgOver_sub, avgOver_uniform_const]
   109	  rw [retained_mass_eq S p1 R hR]

   113	theorem retainedPointOverlap_ge_ordered_error {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   114	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
   115	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))

   118	        2 * extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R reverse - 4 / P.q ≤
   119	      retainedPointOverlap S p1 p2 R (if reverse then .Z else .X) := by
   120	  have h := retainedPointMismatch_le_ordered_error S p1 p2 hopposite R hR reverse
   121	  rw [retainedPointMismatch_eq S p1 p2 hopposite R hR] at h
   122	  linarith

   124	/-- Completion increases the retained diagonal overlap on any opposite
   125	placement. This transports the completion estimate to all four directed
   126	expanded placements, without identifying the player spaces. -/
   127	theorem directPairMeasurement_consistency_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   128	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
   129	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
   130	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) (pair₀ : PolyPair P) (W : PauliKind) :
   131	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   132	      (fun x a => S.place p1 (((directPairMeasurement R pair₀).postprocess
   133	        (evalAt W x)).effect a))
   134	      (fun x a => S.place p2 ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side W x).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤
   135	      separatedPolynomialMass S p1 R + retainedPointMismatch S p1 p2 R W := by
   136	  classical
   137	  let C := directPairMeasurement R pair₀
   138	  let B := fun x => S.pointMeasExp p2.side W x
   139	  have hdiag (x : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   140	      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   141	        (S.place p1 ((C.postprocess (evalAt W x)).effect a) * S.place p2 ((B x).effect a))) =
   142	      ∑ pair : PolyPair P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   143	        (S.place p1 (C.effect pair) * S.place p2 ((B x).effect (evalAt W x pair))) := by
   144	    simp_rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, S.place_finsetSum, Finset.sum_mul,
   145	      stateQForm_finset_sum]
   146	    calc
   147	      _ = ∑ a : PauliScalar P, ∑ pair ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   148	          (fun pair => evalAt W x pair = a), stateQForm S.psiHat
   149	          (S.place p1 (C.effect pair) * S.place p2 ((B x).effect (evalAt W x pair))) := by
   150	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   151	        intro a _
   152	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   153	        intro pair hp
   154	        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2]
   155	      _ = _ := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ (evalAt W x) _
   156	  have hretained (x : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   157	      (∑ pair : PolyPair P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   158	        (S.place p1 (R.effect (directCombinedEmbedding P pair)) *
   159	          S.place p2 ((B x).effect (evalAt W x pair)))) ≤
   160	      ∑ pair : PolyPair P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   161	        (S.place p1 (C.effect pair) * S.place p2 ((B x).effect (evalAt W x pair))) := by
   162	    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   163	    intro pair _
   164	    dsimp only [C, directPairMeasurement]
   165	    rw [completedPairMeasurement_effect, place_add, add_mul, stateQForm_add]
   166	    have heffect : (combinedPairSubmeasurement P
   167	        (canonicalPolynomialMeasurement R)).effect pair =
   168	        R.effect (directCombinedEmbedding P pair) :=
   169	      canonicalPolynomialMeasurement_effect R (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair)
